z cannot be recomputed exactly. The individual incumbent run values and their spread are not given. Only the mean (1.0659 over 2 runs) is reported. The candidate is 1.0659 - 1.063 = 0.0029 lower (better). A z of 0.440 implies a noise scale of about 0.0066, which is plausible but cannot be checked.
